_jokes_verification.method: Jokes from a stand-up special: the special is the primary source and a full transcript of it is the text checked. On 2026-10-23 each transcript page was downloaded as raw HTML and each joke's setup and punchline were string-matched against the page text, ignoring only quote-mark/dash/ellipsis typography and sentence-initial capitals; the setup/punchline split is ours. Wording was not checked against the special's audio. Lines found only on aggregators (quote wikis, listicles) or that the transcript does not carry verbatim are verified=false and stay out of the comic's pool.
_jokes_verification.rule: Only jokes with verified=true are in Next Top Comic's pool (tests/test_quotes_vv.gd).
